notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.37
notes.notes: [p]Truck City v0.37-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improvement: peak RAM usage reduced by ~10% by optimizing UI resources[/p][/*][*][p]Feature: map editor implemented, but not available in the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Feature: map editor integration with steam workshop[/p][/*][*][p]Feature: Esc key will open the menu if Esc is kept pressed for 0.6 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Feature: Added SSIL enable/disable option to Video settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: UI text corrections, translations improved[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.36
notes.notes: [p]Truck City v0.36-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improvement: added video tutorial for the blueprints window, visible when no blueprints exist in the library[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: fixed bug where blueprints would not be correctly loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: building a road out of town after changing market configuration would not correctly set the market configuration[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: minimap color palette changed to improve resource visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: log scrolling corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: building placement rotation may fail in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: improved translations[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: truck depot added as a destination in the truck list window[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: fixed window resizing on blueprints menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved: shortcuts for window management[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.35
notes.notes: [p]Truck City v0.35-Demo has just been released. This change log also includes changes in hotfixes 0.34.1 and 0.34.2. This is the change log:[/p][list][*][p]Improvement: Upgraded Godot engine to version 4.5[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: First run sped up, the game now includes pre-compiled shaders (20% speed-up)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: minimap colors improved to make factories and resources much more visible, visually appealing[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: added level of detail models for containers; makes GPU frame time approximately 10% faster in very factories with far away zoom[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: updated tileset for Oil and Space DEMO map, especially for one way roads[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: performance improvements when using blueprints[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: blueprints system may not save blueprints used by the user, corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: "Map never completed" may show in the objectives menu after completing a map and selecting to stay in the map[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: one way roads in blueprints occasionally may not be correctly built[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: rarely blueprints may be built on top of resources, other buildings, or out of bounds, fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: some blueprints may print "unable to build this blueprint" after building it[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Camera angle changed, camera transition changed[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: better translations for leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: improved look and feel of Leaderboards window[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improvement: added button to go to my rank in Leaderboards window[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: corrected tilemap for 2-tile production buildings next to loading ports[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Truck depot now shows information regarding incoming trucks and occupied and total parking spots[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Added encryption for records file, hopefully preventing or reducing cheating[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: other anti-cheating measures taken to prevent custom maps to inject results on official map leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: changed default traffic light duration to 5s (from 10s)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: factory window will show a cleaner interface at the frame it's loaded (previously might show outdated information)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bugfix: trucks would select a truck depot by distance, disregarding priority[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: changed default shortcut for blueprints menu to Control+B instead of B, so the window can be closed using the same shortcut without interfering with the user typing[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: blueprints with one way roads were not correctly updating the minimap when built[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: manually despawned trucks would still show their route on the map, removed[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: one way tiles changed so right side of the road shows yellow marks and left side shows white marks (as is usually the case in reality)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: clicking on log messages may also trigger clicks below the log too[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: road menu items may be reverse cycled using the Shift+2 shortcut[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Key mapping menu sorted by function key[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Added translation for market menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Removed incorrect tooltip text in global menu[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Information tooltip text window now resets when scrolling or zooming[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bugfix: corrected warning message in factory tooltip text regarding amount of outbound warehouses[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.34
notes.notes: [p]Truck City v0.34-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:[/p][list][*][p]Feature: Trucks list window now allows sorting by column[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bugfix: roundabouts and blueprints including one-way roads now correctly set the road direction[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: camera will be completely top-down (90º) when it's far from the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: factory rounding error that might cause uneven production ratios corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: lowered production speed for rocket launchpads[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: user interface cleanup[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: other minor UI improvements such as faster scrolling in science menu, better placement for loading port menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: traffic light duration defaults to 5, limited to 99 seconds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.33
notes.notes: [p]Truck City v0.33-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:[/p][list][*][p]Feature: search bar in loading port building menu is now always visible.[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672321/48095f429c7bdf4ff2e1a03eddca2c5b9ab8abb2.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: tutorial 1 added road tile next to loading port to make the tutorial more intuitive[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: tutorial 3 will wait until sufficient input warehouses are built, and will wait for individual factories to be completed before jumping to the next one[/p][/*][*][p]Feature: loading ports missing buildings will show a flashing ! sign on top of them.
